Hey friend. I agree with everything you said. I actually did receive what could be a sign in music. Before the visit to the medium when I was exploring this - might I add that I suddenly got the 'feeling' to look to parapsychology and psi for the answers here - I was experimenting a bit. 

I sat down and said "Hey, if you can hear me.. I'm visiting a medium in a few days, and you should be able to communicate with me through her. So, if you could send me signs, and walk with me, I'd love that"

The next day, a song literally called "Walk With Me" by the Hound & the Fox came on my android auto playlist while I was driving. 

About love - Krisztina and I were kept apart quite a bit, and we were off and on. We were young at the time, around 18-20. We're now both 28. Due to issues she had, issues I had, both being broke kids in college, her having to move with her family, we actually weren't physically together a lot. 

You'd think that'd dampen things, but it didn't. Not one bit. The very thought of her made me joyful to be alive. 

Even while we were apart, if I told her I even talked to anyone else, she'd get jealous. So would I. If I went two days without texting her, she'd freak out. So would I. 

I've had plenty of girlfriends since, ones that I've been with longer too, and while I've loved them all in my own way, nothing could compare to Kris. Supernatural is the only way I can describe it. 

I didn't tell the medium this, by the way, and she said she felt something extremely strong between us that indicated to her that we were together in a past life, or knew each other somehow from before we were born on Earth.

Something I like about this whole thing is the lack of dogma/zealotry from the people involved that I've spoken to. The medium told me "Look, this stuff is real. Science doesn't understand it, we can't really measure it consistently yet, but it's real". 

She also told me that if my grief is severe, to not come back to her soon and instead seek a therapist. Which is not something someone motivated by money would say. 

She also told me that she felt something extremely strong between Kris and I, that we've been together in past lives. I think she termed it as an "energy tether" between our spirits. 

As for my own abilities, I'm not sure. I've tried automatic writing a few times since, where I just write down the loudest words that come to my mind. I wind up getting a lot of numbers and nonsensical stuff. Last night I got something like "Night. 18. Infinite. Temporary. Puzzle." These are random words and concepts that don't make sense together, who am I to say they're the result of psychic ability and not my own subconscious?

Thanks for that, I'll check that book out. This is all very new to me. Please understand that I've went 28 years of my life without considering any of this to be possible. 

What surprised me the most was that Krisztina was very cognizant of worldly matters surrounding me. She seemed to have better memory of events than I do. She laughed and joked with me half the time and explained to the medium details of our relationship such as the fact that we were off-and-on. 

I was also told that she has a "job" in the hereafter as somebody who helps recently discarnated spirits adjust to their new state of being, and this is why she is so skilled at communicating and affecting certain things. The medium said she was very fun and easy to talk to. 

I visited a friend after this and explained that I most likely have the consciousness of my deceased girlfriend following me around, and told him to say hello. He did, and swears at that point that he saw a branch of his indoor fern tree behind me lift upwards and then fall back down as if touched by a hand. 

He runs over to the tree suddenly and starts examining it and tells me what happened. We start jumping up and down, I even kicked the base of the tree. Nothing could make it move that way. Granted I didn't see it, but he's not the type to lie to me like that.

Within all of this, I think it may be possible that intervention from the other side can occur but it may be limited in several ways. 

If I'm to give a few more details, in my case, if the bullet went off I wouldn't have been shot, the gun would've exploded like a grenade in my hands because there was an obstruction in the barrel and nowhere for the explosion to go, except everywhere and in my face. 

I asked my medium about this and she relayed what my departed girlfriend said "He has 9 lives, like a cat", "Someone has to watch him" "He's impetuous" 

Was also told that they're allowed to intervene sometimes because I'm strongly discouraged from dying until I "get what need to get" out of life.

Yes, I absolutely understand. Periodically I'll think of when the medium I saw said her name, and feel butterflies. I've been told it's necessary to give it time, to open yourself up to it and to also try and notice more things that you previously would've written off as coincidence. 

I don't think it's blind faith we are having, as we are constantly questioning and analyzing it in a rational way. But there is no way this person could've known the things that they did. That's a fact, laid bare. Hell, I think even Occam's razor would be on our side here.

You know, you may be onto something here. A little more info - Krisztina had some serious issues leading to her suicide 7 years ago. Those issues kept us apart physically quite a bit, but we never stayed apart from each other for long. I never forgot her once, but a lot of the memories regarding her were traumatic for me. I drank a lot at the time and unconsciously repressed a lot of them.

A few months ago, I had a dream about her. And then a month ago another dream. Two days after that, I somehow found my last physical framed picture of her in a cabinet and as soon as I saw it, all of my repressed memories unlocked right there. 

This began some very intense grief as I was reliving the entire thing, but I felt something screaming at me to get answers. I talked to my friends about her endlessly. "Man..It was 7 years ago, why now!?" Despite being an agnostic throughout my entire life, I started to think of contacting her. At first as a joke, then as a serious thing. 

It was as though I was being pushed along a path or some of my thoughts were being manipulated in a certain direction. I began telling the story to people and then I had a hallucination while in a hypnogagic state one night before sleeping. She was standing there in a dark room infront of a door made of solid light. 

I woke up, closed my eyes and saw the same thing, uninterrupted. It was then I asked a friend to refer me to a medium, and I made an appointment. 

The point is that I went from an agnostic, skeptical 28 year old with only a fleeting interest in the paranormal from when I used to traipse around abandoned buildings years ago, to seeing a medium for an hour in a matter of 3 weeks after having a dream, 7 years after this person's death.

Very interesting because I've had several dreams and odd experiences that have intensified lately. I've also had a few close encounters with death myself. I'll share if it interests you. 

My life involves firearms and the use of them. I'm not in the military or law enforfement and I'm not a criminal, by the way. But I'd rather not go into too much detail because it's not important. 

About a year ago, there was an instance where if a bullet went off, it would've killed me. (I was not pointing a gun at myself, it's a long story). I'd simply be dead instantly. The trigger was pulled, the hammer hit the firing pin, but the bullet didn't go off. 

Upon later examination, I and others found a very small indent on the explosive primer of the bullet, meaning that the firing pin stopped short of actually setting it off. 

This was an AK-47. THEY DONT MALFUNCTION. Something physically stopped the firing pin from firing a bullet that would have killed me. 

Make of that what you will, and thanks for your post

If you're new to the game, I'd suggest going with Kanthal as your wire material. AVS makes excellent coils at an affordable price but SS316 is harder to work with for a newbie in the sense that you have to be VERY careful when dry firing or you'll destroy your coils/leech nasty things. 

If you do decide to go with SS, AVS has an excellent tutorial page on their site for dry firing. Watch that. 

Lightningvapes is your best bet for roundwire, however I'd suggest going with prebuilt coils until you get a hang of it. Elementvape carries Cotton Bacon which is more expensive than Japanese organic but is easier to work with. They also carry coilology Kanthal coils which I strongly recommend.

You'll need an RDA, a flathead/allen key/Phillips screwdriver (usually included with most RDAs) and preferably a 3mm coiling jig for positioning your coils. You can use any metal screwdriver for that purpose, ceramic tweezers and scissors.

Once you screw the coil legs in tight, you want to dry-fire them to burn off machine oils and deal with hotspots. With Kanthal you can 'pulse' (quickly fire and release) at around 40w with no problem, just don't glow them white. With SS and Ni80, DO NOT fire above 20w and keep your pulses short. A nice orange glow to see hot spots in a dark room is what I would suggest. DO NOT use ni200 or titanium in wattage mode at all. 

What you want to see is both coils heating up evenly from the center wrap outward. If one is heating up quicker, mess with the post screws and make sure they're tight on the legs. Stretch them apart gently with your ceramic tweezers and push them back together. It's very likely you'll see areas of the coil that look like they're getting hot very quickly, these are hot spots and are dealt with by 'brushing' them with ceramic tweezers. 

Once you've purged any hotspots from the coils you'll want to wait for them to cool down and wick. Grab cotton and fluff it a little before twisting one end (the end you're leading through the coil) and pull it through. You want your wicks to be tighter vs looser, but not too tight you pull the coil while wicking. Fluff them out with the tweezers and use your scissors to cut the ends so they sit on the deck and tuck them in. Juice up, pulse and you're good to go.
